name: Jia Jie Biomedical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jia Jie Biomedical Co., Ltd., headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, was established in 1995. Formerly known as Murad Chia Jei Biotechnology Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in June 2019, the company primarily specializes in the production and distribution of health foods and wellness products across both Taiwan and Mainland China. The company's core operations encompass the processing, sale, and trade of softshell turtle-derived food items, as well as the manufacturing of dairy products. Its diversified food portfolio also features a range of specialty items such as softshell turtle egg powder capsules, enzyme powders, tortoise jelly, softshell turtle oil, and various other encapsulated nutritional supplements. Beyond its food production, Jia Jie Biomedical engages in comprehensive import/export activities, product distribution, and managing bidding and quotation procedures for its offerings. It also operates as a wholesaler for a broad array of consumer goods, including non-alcoholic beverages, confectioneries, baked goods, dietary supplements, general groceries, everyday household items, and cosmetics. Further expanding its business scope, the company manufactures water purification systems and their associated components, provides brokerage services for life and property insurance, and invests in the research, development, and production of advanced aquatic product technologies and various biological solutions.
